selection_reason: CSW-06 completed_verified in PR #433. APM-03 and CSW-06 satisfy APM-04 dependencies; owner-approved interleave selects APM-04 before CSW-07.
objective: Define a bounded AutoGM Mini-Campaign Director that extends the verified single-encounter runner across a short multi-scene Adventure graph while preserving deterministic mechanical authority, hidden information, player choice, continuity/open-thread evidence, alternate routes, interruption recovery and explicit end conditions without becoming unlimited autonomous campaign generation.
completion_gate: A bounded short multi-scene solo Adventure can select valid routes, run one encounter/scene at a time, preserve open threads/continuity/hidden information, pause/resume safely and reach one of explicit end conditions while all mechanics remain owning-domain deterministic and optional AI remains presentation/candidate-only.
required_design_questions: What exact mini-campaign package/run state bounds scenes, graph size, step/event budget and end conditions?
How is a governed/CSW-derived Adventure graph converted into an AutoGM scenario authority package without making CSW planning authoritative?
How are route eligibility, prerequisites, optional content, convergence/divergence and failure routes chosen deterministically from current committed state?
How does the director invoke APM-03 encounters as child runs while keeping one attributable parent history?
What non-encounter scene operations can the controller perform and which remain human/proposal/GM-required?
How are hooks/revelations/open threads tracked between scenes without leaking unrevealed information?
How are CSW-06 continuity candidates used as internal safety/advisory signals without rewriting Adventure truth mid-run?
How are player choices between routes represented and how does the controller avoid railroading or inventing unavailable branches?
How do Character/resource/investigation/relationship/world changes from one scene become exact inputs to later route eligibility?
How are optional AI narration/dialogue/summaries bounded to player-safe resolved projections across scenes?
How do pause/resume/version drift/duplicate child-run completion and partial-scene recovery work?
What bounded endings exist for success, failure, retreat, abandonment, unresolved/open ending and out-of-scope fail-safe?
What deterministic acceptance fixtures prove same-input route/mechanical replay where the package promises determinism?
preserved_parallel_tracks: APW-05 remains later in approved sequence
next_action: Execute APM-04 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining mini-campaign package/run/graph state, scene/route orchestration, APM-03 child-run composition, continuity/open-thread/hidden-info handling, persistence/recovery, deterministic route/mechanical replay and optional-AI presentation boundaries.
